description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM system, used for filtering employee skill search results based on employee number and sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) extending FilterParams, used for managing search filter parameters for employee skills, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams object and sets default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
